capabilities: Drag blocks to reorder paragraphs, headings, quotes, callouts, and code blocks
Reorder list items together with their nested children
Swap adjacent sections of the same level and parent after a preview
Convert blocks into headings, bullets, tasks, quotes, or callouts
Copy or create native block IDs and extract blocks into a linked new note
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian community directory and must be installed manually from GitHub Releases; mobile and Windows/Linux support are pending physical-device verification; version 0.1.6 is unreleased; free with voluntary WeChat Pay/Alipay tips.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in drag-and-drop handles for moving paragraphs, list items, or sections within a note, nor a quick menu for block-level actions.

relations.evidence: SixDots brings Notion-style block actions to Obsidian.

summary: Block-manipulation plugin that adds a drag handle for reordering Markdown blocks and a menu of quick actions like formatting, block links, and note extraction.
